strengthGuide: Compare the overall case for each direction. Look at the different consequences in the accepted arguments. Consider all of the effects, not only the strongest one. Do not count headings. If two arguments describe the same consequence, count it once. Good evidence for an effect does not mean that the effect is large. There is no formula to calculate a winner. Choose Pending if you have no justified comparison.
mappingGuide: Does a shared claim seem too broad for this argument? Does a supporting path seem to be missing? Explain the problem in the optional note. Change your shared-claim answer only if your view of that claim changed. A coordinator reviews these notes. Your earlier answers stay saved.
legacyReleaseLabel: Release not recorded (saved before release tracking)
coordinatorGuide: Review each mapping note and record one outcome: No mapping change, Mapping revised or Unresolved. A corrected mapping recomputes the outcomes. An argument with a viable path needs a direct judgment. The app derives No only when every path is blocked. If the dispute continues, keep it Unresolved. Earlier answers stay saved.
releaseMismatchMessage: This page does not match the current release (${key}). Reload this page before coding.

laterEvidenceNote: Some sources are dated after the comparison date. They are used when they bear on what the bill would have done compared with the law on that date. They do not change the law used for the comparison.
originalViewNotice: This is the earlier wording, kept for the record. It may include wording that was later corrected.
